# tth-riemann : Tensors and Spatial Curvature (Python)

`tth-riemann` relies on the `libtth-diff` engine to analyze the non-Euclidean geometry generated by the transformation.

## ⚙️ Features

* Mapping of the determinant of the induced Riemannian metric $g_{ij}(x)$.
* Calculation of the second spatial derivatives to estimate the Gaussian Curvature $K$.
* Formal demonstration of the emergence of a non-zero curvature dynamically generated by weighted interactions.
* Visualization of geometric gravity wells, drawing a direct analogy with general relativity.
